minecraft:particle_initialization.per_update_expression: v.bl = math.clamp(math.max(v.entity_width, v.entity_height), 0.5, 3.0);v.fs = math.clamp(0.45 + 0.5 * v.bl, 0.7, 1.9);v.te = v.particle_age + 0.075;v.ox = -v.target_deltax;v.oy = v.target_deltay + 0.05;v.oz = -v.target_deltaz;v.ux = 0;v.uy = 0.55 * math.min(v.entity_height, 3.2);v.uz = -0.2 * v.entity_width;v.dl = math.max(math.sqrt(math.pow(v.ox - v.ux, 2) + math.pow(v.oz - v.uz, 2)), 0.01);v.qx = (v.ox + v.ux) / 2 + 0.2 * v.dl * (v.oz - v.uz) / v.dl;v.qy = (v.oy + v.uy) / 2 + 0.18 * v.dl + 0.3;v.qz = (v.oz + v.uz) / 2 - 0.2 * v.dl * (v.ox - v.ux) / v.dl;v.fk = math.clamp((v.te - 1.46) / 0.42, 0, 1);v.s = v.fk * v.fk * (3 - 2 * v.fk);v.cx = (1 - v.s) * (1 - v.s) * v.ox + 2 * (1 - v.s) * v.s * v.qx + v.s * v.s * v.ux;v.cy = (1 - v.s) * (1 - v.s) * v.oy + 2 * (1 - v.s) * v.s * v.qy + v.s * v.s * v.uy + 0.04 * math.sin(v.te * 720) * (1 - v.fk);v.cz = (1 - v.s) * (1 - v.s) * v.oz + 2 * (1 - v.s) * v.s * v.qz + v.s * v.s * v.uz;
